acl_entries.description: List of administrator permission entries. Each entry grants specific administrative rights to a principal.

permissions.description: Permission string: combination of characters (a=add, d=delete, m=modify, c=change password, i=init, r=read, w=write, * = all). Use 'a' for full admin rights, or combinations like 'i' for initialization-only access.

entries.description: Optional list of database entries ( principals or patterns) this permission applies to. If omitted, the permission applies to all entries.

items.description: A principal pattern (e.g., *, admin/*, user/*) or exact principal name (e.g., user1@EXAMPLE.COM)
